clue.text: Work at home — no-one's up to give a view

parts.note: op, short for opus, is a work
someone at home is in

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means these pieces are read from the bottom, so backwards

parts.note: taken as written
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Someone working from home finds no-one willing to offer an opinion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns NO + I into ION, which ends the answer after OP and IN.
explanation.definitionFit: Giving a view is offering one's judgement or belief, which is the noun's sense here used loosely as the thing given.

clue.text: The lack of guilt is in no way reported!

indicators.note: reported means the phrase is spoken, so what counts is how it sounds

parts.note: in no way means in no sense

explanation.surface: An exclamation that a lack of guilt is not mentioned at all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in no way' means 'in no sense', and said aloud that phrase is the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Being free of guilt is the plain meaning of the word: blamelessness.

clue.text: Dearie me! The French do jeer

parts.note: heck is a mild exclamation like dearie me
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Someone exclaims in dismay at the French jeering.
explanation.definitionFit: To jeer at a speaker is to barrack or interrupt them with taunts.

clue.text: Pleasure seeker who is yet perhaps found outside the pub

indicators.note: found outside says the scrambled letters sit around the other piece
perhaps suggests the letters of is yet may be arranged some other way

parts.note: a pub is a bar

explanation.surface: A hedonist is likely to be found standing outside the pub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' rearranges IS YET to SYITE, and 'found outside' wraps it around BAR: SY-BAR-ITE.
explanation.definitionFit: A sybarite, after the luxurious ancient city of Sybaris, is a person devoted to luxury and indulgence.

clue.text: Unexpected boost following encouragement

definitions.meaning: a spontaneous, unplanned thing is done on impulse
read literally, a spur is a boost and of the moment means current or following the fashion

explanation.surface: An impromptu boost given after some encouragement.
explanation.definitionFit: Done on impulse or without planning; literally, a goad that is topical.

clue.text: "Rettan" means "cheek"

parts.note: this made-up word is natter, a word for chat, spelt backwards

explanation.surface: A dictionary entry glossing an odd foreign-looking word as cheek.
explanation.walkthrough: Rettan is natter written backwards, so it is chat back: the answer, rude replies.
explanation.definitionFit: Impudent answering back is insolence, also called lip.

clue.text: Lines that professionals know?

definitions.meaning: cords and cables on a ship are lines
an expert is said to know the ..., meaning the procedures

explanation.surface: Pondering which lines experts are familiar with.
explanation.definitionFit: Ropes are cords; knowing the ropes is the idiom for being experienced.

clue.text: Why one left a last job?

definitions.text: Why one left a last job?

parts.words: Why one left a last job?
parts.note: a person sacked leaves their final job; a cobbler's last is the foot-shaped block footwear is made on, so footwear also leaves the last

explanation.surface: Asking why someone departed from their most recent employment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'last' looks like 'most recent', but it is also a shoemaker's last.
explanation.definitionFit: Being sacked is the reason one quits a post; footwear leaves a cobbler's block when finished.

clue.text: Parasite often found in the bath

definitions.meaning: a freeloader who lives off others
a soft absorbent washing aid kept by the tub

explanation.surface: A parasitic creature that turns up in the bathtub.
explanation.definitionFit: A scrounger is called by this word; it is also the porous object used for washing.

clue.text: Unlike international rugby players' teeth?

parts.note: players who represent their country are capped, and teeth can be capped by a dentist; these are neither

explanation.surface: Wondering how rugby internationals' teeth differ from others.
explanation.walkthrough: A cap is awarded for playing for one's country, and also a crown fitted on a tooth.
explanation.definitionFit: Never selected for the national side, or with no crowns fitted on the teeth.

clue.text: Spectator's view restricted by one to the right

indicators.note: restricted by means the view is held within the letters of one

parts.note: taken as written
to view is to look
R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: A spectator's line of sight is blocked by someone on their right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spectator's' is read as 'Spectator is'; LOOK goes inside ONE, then R follows.
explanation.definitionFit: An observer watching events, a bystander, is a spectator.

clue.text: Wheel needing some oil?

definitions.meaning: a small swivelling wheel on furniture
add the word oil and it becomes the laxative oil from the bean plant

explanation.surface: A squeaky wheel wanting lubrication.
explanation.definitionFit: A swivel wheel under a chair bears this name, and so does the bean oil.

clue.text: Why is one fated to fail at audition?

definitions.text: Why is one fated to fail at audition?

indicators.note: to fail suggests the letters of one fated go wrong and are rearranged

explanation.surface: Asking why a performer seems doomed to flop at every audition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to fail' rearranges ONE and FATED; the whole clue also explains why a singer cannot pass.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who cannot distinguish pitch would sing badly and fail a singing trial.

clue.text: Attempt to hide an American waistcoat — a poor imitation!

indicators.note: to hide means the attempt keeps the other pieces within it

parts.note: an attempt is a try
an is the article a
Americans call a waistcoat a vest

explanation.surface: Trying to conceal a US waistcoat produces only a shoddy copy.
explanation.definitionFit: A grotesque parody or mockery of something is a cheap imitation of it.

clue.text: The visionary effect of key positive coaches

parts.note: E is a musical key
yes is a positive reply
to coach is to train

explanation.surface: A mystical vision produced by a key that encourages positive coaching.
explanation.definitionFit: Tired, sore vision is an effect on sight, so visionary here means of the eyes.

clue.text: The cheapest accommodation is always in the theatre

indicators.note: in places the word for always inside the theatre word

parts.note: the stage is the theatre as a profession
e'er is a poetic form of ever, always

explanation.surface: The cheapest seats are always found in the theatre.
explanation.definitionFit: On passenger ships, the lowest class of travel below decks was the cheapest berth.

clue.text: Most nations agree to worry

parts.note: the UN, United Nations, includes most nations
to settle is to agree terms

explanation.surface: Most nations agree to fret.
explanation.definitionFit: To disturb or upset someone is to make them anxious.

clue.text: Where one might snort, confusing the Italian?

definitions.text: Where one might snort, confusing the Italian?

indicators.note: confusing means the letters of snort are jumbled

parts.note: il is Italian for the

explanation.surface: Someone snorts in a way that baffles an Italian.
explanation.walkthrough: 'confusing' rearranges SNORT to NOSTR, then IL is added.
explanation.definitionFit: Each opening of the nose is where air, or snuff, is drawn in sharply.

clue.text: Fail to pay for flat due for demolition

indicators.note: for demolition says the letters of flat due are knocked down and rebuilt

explanation.surface: A flat due to be knocked down leaves its owner unable to pay.
explanation.definitionFit: Failing to meet a debt repayment is to renege on it.

clue.text: After a short time, misses treacle!

indicators.note: after puts the second piece following the first

parts.note: mo is short for moment
misses are young women, lasses

explanation.surface: Someone misses out on the treacle after a moment.
explanation.definitionFit: This dark syrup from sugar refining is the American name for treacle.

clue.text: Inclined to fib about the way to Germany

indicators.note: about means the word for fib goes around the way

parts.note: to fib is to lie
St is short for street, a way
D is the international vehicle code for Germany

explanation.surface: A traveller is prone to lying about the route to Germany.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship that leans to one side is tilted, or inclined.

clue.text: Spirit concealed by tipsy chefs?

indicators.note: concealed by means the letters sit within the words tipsy chefs

explanation.surface: Liquor hidden away by chefs who drink.
explanation.definitionFit: The soul or mind of a person is their inner spirit.

clue.text: The links or the range?

definitions.meaning: a row of mountains, as in a mountain range

explanation.surface: Asking whether golf links or a mountain range is meant.
explanation.definitionFit: Joined metal rings form one; so does a line of mountains.

clue.text: One in the wind results in poor hearing

indicators.note: in places the numeral within the wind's name

parts.note: the mistral is a cold wind of southern France
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: One person standing in a gale cannot hear properly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hearing' looks like the sense of sound; here it is a court hearing.
explanation.definitionFit: A trial voided by error is a flawed court hearing.

clue.text: A long time on holiday causes damage

indicators.note: on means the long time comes after the holiday

parts.note: a break is a holiday
an age is a long time

explanation.surface: A long time on holiday causes harm.
explanation.definitionFit: Broken goods, things smashed, are damage done.

clue.text: In a bad way? Yes!

parts.note: the question asks for a word for wickedly, and the exclamation confirms the answer ends with a Y sound like yes

explanation.surface: An emphatic agreement that things are going badly.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting wickedly or malevolently is acting in a bad way.

clue.text: Man on programme sounding mournful

indicators.note: on means the man comes after the programme

parts.note: a programme is a plan
a gent is a man

explanation.surface: A man on a programme sounds sad.
explanation.definitionFit: A plaintive, resonant tone sounds sorrowful.
